title: Delhi HC Turns a 2022 Interim Order Into a Final Decree on Amitabh Bachchan's Personality Rights
case_name: Amitabh Bachchan v. Rajat Nagi and Others
card_summary: Amitabh Bachchan sued in 2022 after an app developer put out a 'video call' app using his persona and a publisher printed a quiz book carrying his photograph without consent. Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav decreed the suit, folding the 2022 interim injunction into a final, permanent decree restraining the defendants and unidentified future infringers from commercially using his name, image, voice or likeness.
card_tip: Personality rights suits in Delhi usually stall at the interim stage for years; this decree shows the Delhi HC IPD Rules can take one through to a final, binding injunction.
verification_notes: Case number CS(COMM) 819/2022, bench (Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav), decision date (5 Nov 2026) and the app/quiz-book defendants confirmed consistently across Bar and Bench, LiveLaw Biz and Free Press Journal. The 2022 interim order date (25 Nov 2022) and its merger into the final decree also consistent across sources. Full decree text not opened; wording is as reported.
